CONCIERGE & HARDWARE WARRANTY

Dedicated support.
Complete peace of mind.

What materials are used in Azure Ultra and One Pro?

Azure Ultra and One Pro are crafted from forged Grade-5 aerospace titanium billets with micro-blasted ceramic shield glass and sapphire crystal lens coatings.

What warranty and concierge coverage is included?

Every handset includes two years of global hardware warranty, battery replacement coverage, and 24/7 dedicated hardware concierge assistance.

Does the Azure Watch integrate seamlessly with all Azure phones?

Yes. Azure Watch connects instantly via Ultra-Wideband (UWB2) and Bluetooth 5.4, streaming real-time biometric metrics, notifications, and satellite health telemetry.

Are international 5G frequencies supported?

AZURE devices feature 64 5G NR bands, simultaneous sub-6GHz and mmWave, Wi-Fi 7 multi-link aggregation, and Dual Active eSIM architecture for seamless global roaming.
